fib: ______ is a type of accounting that generates information to managers within an organization to enable them take decisions.
Management Accounting
Management Accounting is a type of accounting that generates information to managers within an organization to enable them take decisions.
______ is defined by CIMA as the standard labour cost of any change from the standard level of labour efficiency.
Direct labour efficiency variance
Direct labour efficiency variance is defined by CIMA as the standard labour cost of any change from the standard level of labour efficiency.
______ is an accounting practice where companies use financial statements to communicate the company's financial performance at a particular period to the users.
Financial reporting
Financial reporting is an accounting practice where companies use financial statements to communicate the company's financial performance at a particular period to the users.
______ are the difference in cost between alternatives or between one alternative and another.
Differential or avoidable costs
Differential or avoidable costs are the difference in cost between alternatives or between one alternative and another.

Break- even Point (BEP) analysis
Break- even Point analysis
BEP

Standard

Standard costing
